new_packages.label: שָׁלֹשׁ רְגָלִים וְתִקּוּנָם
new_packages.reason: If we add the three individual festivals (Pesach, Shavuot, Sukkot) as nodes with bechina edges to their respective repairs (each festival IS the repair of one desire), this would expand Package 3 (Daat/Festivals) with three more explicit bechina pairs. This does not create a NEW independent package but rather enriches Package 3.
new_packages.assessment: These are borderline eitza/bechina. The festivals REPAIR the desires (eitza), but the Rebbe also presents them as parallel aspects — each festival's essence IS the tikkun of a specific desire. If treated as bechina, they would merge Packages 1 and 3 into a single mega-package. Recommendation: keep as proposed additions to be reviewed.

observations: Since reference 1001 had ZERO bechina edges in the existing dataset, the entire package structure is built fresh from source text analysis. The Torah's bechina structure is rich: 55 parallel-aspect relationships connecting 58 unique concepts across 11 raw connected components, which consolidate into 5 packages after merging by thematic family. No truly independent new package domain of 3+ bechina-connected concepts was found beyond what is already captured in the 5 proposed packages. The one candidate (individual festivals linked to specific desires) is borderline eitza/bechina and is flagged for review rather than proposed as a firm new package.
